'''Samwil Hark''' is a cutpurse in [[Caemlyn]].  

== Appearance ==
He is average weight and height and has brown hair and eyes. He has an ordinary looking face.

== Activities ==
He is one of the most skilled and successful cut-purses in Caemlyn, cutting thousands over the course of at least 20 years. He keeps the cut purses in a chest as trophies of his conquests. When he was turned in by a rival, rather than having him imprisoned [[Elayne Trakand]] asked him to follow [[Daved Hanlon|Doilin Mellar]].  Hark led Elayne, some [[Aes Sedai]] and multiple queens guards to arrest Mellar.
